exploit_name: LPs can withdraw required assets locking long position closures
description: maxWithdraw allows withdrawal up to s_depositedAssets - 1, unaware that active long positions require liquidity for return.
attack_scenario: LP deposits 100. Seller shorts 10 (deposited). Buyer longs 1. LP withdraws 97. Buyer cannot close long due to insufficient pool liquidity.
root_cause: maxWithdraw allows withdrawal up to s_depositedAssets - 1, unaware that active long positions require liquidity for return.
fix_description: Reserve assets needed for active long positions in withdrawal calculation.
notes: Long holders trapped in positions, unable to exit even when at losses. Potential whale LP griefing.
